title: Intention
description: An intention. Class-level properties describe the intention type/category. Instance-level properties describe a concrete intention formed by an agent at a specific time.

run_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the run this intention belongs to.

agent_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the agent that formed the intention.

timestamp_s.description: [instance-level] Simulated time in seconds when the intention was formed.

version.description: [class-level] Schema version of the intention record format.

target_instance_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the object instance the intention targets, if any.

target_type_id.description: [class-level] Identifier of the target object's type, if known.

thought.description: [instance-level] The agent's natural-language rationale for forming this intention.

status.description: [instance-level] Current lifecycle status of the intention.

examples.thought: I want to learn whether the coconut moves when touched.
